description: Synthetic RECALL fixture (the first blind recall test — all prior blind runs were precision/clean-baselines). A ~56-line exporter module with a GENUINE unnamed multi-adapter seam: export_report() dispatches on fmt to three sibling adapters (_export_csv / _export_json / _export_parquet) with substantively DIFFERENT logic. Per LANGUAGE.md ('a real seam has ≥2 adapters') this IS a real deepening opportunity — formalize an Exporter Protocol + adapters + registry. The skill MUST find it (Strong/Worth). Doubles as a guard-balance test: confirm the DRY-is-not-deepening guard (ADR-0003) does NOT over-suppress a genuine ≥2-adapter seam (it isn't thin-plumbing DRY — the adapters differ: csv flattening, json envelope, parquet/pyarrow).
_line_ranges_verified: 2026-05-21 against the bundled fixture (56 lines): config-at-edge env reads 9-10, the seam (export_report dispatcher + _export_csv/_export_json/_export_parquet adapters) 13-56.

expected_candidates.deepening_target: Introduce an `Exporter` Protocol + `CsvExporter` / `JsonExporter` / `ParquetExporter` adapters + a format→adapter registry; export_report() becomes a one-line lookup+dispatch. The seam already has THREE real adapters chosen by `if/elif fmt`; it is real but unnamed. Formalizing makes adding a 4th format (xlsx) a registry entry instead of a dispatcher edit, and isolates per-format testing.
expected_candidates.rationale: Per LANGUAGE.md: 'A real seam has ≥ 2 adapters.' Here there are 3, each with substantively different implementation (csv flattening of nested values, json {rows,count} envelope, pyarrow table + compression). This is genuine deepening — NOT the thin-plumbing DRY the DRY-is-not-deepening guard suppresses. Pull complexity downward: dispatcher → registry lookup; per-format quirks hide inside the adapters.
expected_candidates.ousterhout_pattern: Pull complexity downward (mirror of the real summarize.py Summarizer-Protocol win, ADR-0001).

expected_avoidances.why_not_flagged: Configuration-at-edge is the recommended pattern, not complecting. Flagging it would be the bug.

expected_outcome_summary.verdict_if_within_limits: pass — skill FINDS the real 3-adapter exporter seam (Strong or Worth-exploring) and does NOT over-flag config-at-edge. Validates recall AND that the DRY guard does not suppress genuine multi-adapter seams.
expected_outcome_summary.failure_modes_this_catches: (a) MISSES the seam (recall gap); (b) UNDER-RATES it as Speculative because the DRY guard over-corrected (the guard suppressing real seams = a regression introduced by ADR-0003).
